name: Patrick Leahy
summary: Leahy supported progressive taxation, expanded public health coverage and public investment. His record combined civil-liberties and reproductive-rights advocacy with international cooperation and accountability for military abuses.

universal-healthcare.rationale: He cosponsored the Medicare for All Act establishing national health insurance.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: He expressly endorsed the preceding floor argument for gradually raising the federal minimum wage to $15.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: He helped unveil a plan restoring the top income rate and increasing taxes on corporations and high earners.

unions-good.rationale: He supported employee organizing rights and legislation facilitating union formation.

regulate-corporations.rationale: His joint letters urged antitrust investigation of dominant technology companies and insisted they remain subject to competition law.

surveillance-ok.rationale: He sought to end mass telephone-record collection while retaining targeted surveillance authorities with judicial safeguards.

strong-leader.rationale: He rejected congressional submission to presidential initiatives he considered unconstitutional.

state-harmful.rationale: He promoted public investment as necessary for jobs, communities and economic development.

limit-guns.rationale: He coauthored federal restrictions and criminal penalties addressing straw purchasing and firearms trafficking.

rehabilitation.rationale: His recorded criminal-justice position prioritises rehabilitation and treatment for first offenders.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: He defended an equal legal right to marry regardless of gender and backed nationwide recognition.

abortion-legal.rationale: He defended access to safe abortion and urged passage of the Women’s Health Protection Act.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: He advocated accelerating the clean-energy transition through federal renewable-energy, grid and resilience investments.

tax-inheritance.rationale: His jointly unveiled infrastructure plan restored estate and gift taxes reduced in 2017.

state-directs-investment.rationale: He backed strategic federal investment in renewable energy, grid infrastructure and regional development.

political-violence-never.rationale: He explicitly allowed military force if necessary to secure Iraqi disarmament, while rejecting a premature invasion mandate.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: He defended unrestricted encryption and opposed compulsory key recovery and government-access devices.

force-without-un.rationale: He preferred multilateral action but explicitly denied that necessary U.S. security action should be hostage to the UN.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: No stated position on distinct legal roles for men and women in public life; his abortion stance is something nearby.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: He criticised politicians catering to major donors over their constituents’ demands.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: He explained that his law seeks justice for atrocities by foreign military and police units and rejects impunity.

night-watchman-state.rationale: He advocated extensive federal infrastructure, housing, schools, energy and public-health investment.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: He explicitly defended interracial marriage and condemned its historical denial.

consent-of-governed.rationale: He contrasted government genuinely representing voters with decisions driven by undisclosed financial interests.

separated-powers.rationale: In 2025 he demanded that Congress act as an independently elected branch checking unconstitutional presidential actions.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: He praised NATO cooperation against Russia rather than abandonment of the alliance.

death-penalty.rationale: He called capital punishment irreversibly error-prone, racially biased, ineffective and beneath the nation.

religious-exemptions.rationale: He cosponsored restrictions on exemptions harming third parties while leaving the general religious-accommodation framework in place.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: His resolution called for more international resources for mine clearance and assistance to victims across affected countries.

flat-income-tax.rationale: His proposal preserved progressive taxation and raised the highest marginal rate.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: He insisted that Congress and courts confront unconstitutional executive conduct.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: He endorsed judicial review blocking unconstitutional initiatives despite their presidential backing.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: He publicly supported affirmative action rather than abolishing it.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: He cosponsored legislation preventing religious exemptions from overriding antidiscrimination protections.

corporate-influence.rationale: He argued that corporate dark money overwhelms ordinary voters and distorts elected officials’ priorities.

non-intervention.rationale: He supported a force-backed international inspection regime and envisaged circumstances warranting troops in Iraq.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: He defended federal recognition and legal protection of marriage rather than withdrawing its legal status.

public-access-to-information.rationale: He defended public access to government information and authored reforms strengthening the presumption of openness.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: He cosponsored legislation preventing mandatory arbitration from keeping sexual-assault and harassment claims out of court.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: He praised U.S. leadership uniting NATO allies against Russian aggression.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: He described concentrated political spending as undermining democracy and drowning out grassroots voices.

abolish-ip.rationale: He called a balanced patent-protection system essential to innovation, prosperity and jobs.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: He allowed force to overcome Iraqi resistance to disarmament inspections, rather than limiting action to repelling an attack.

future-generations.rationale: His criticism of Paris withdrawal stressed duties toward future generations and the planet.

farm-price-support.rationale: He authored an amendment raising milk price supports and managing surplus production to protect dairy farmers.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: He advanced sentencing safety-valve legislation allowing judges to depart from mandatory punishments.

notes: Later clear positions take precedence over earlier votes. Opposition to the 2002 Iraq authorization was not treated as absolute pacifism: his own speech allowed coercive inspections and force under specified circumstances. Encryption advocacy coexisted with targeted surveillance powers. Marijuana federalism was not extended to legalising all recreational drugs. Antipersonnel-mine advocacy does not establish a position on every category of armament. Cosponsorship alone is medium confidence; quotations by colleagues and other speakers in collective records are not assigned to Leahy. Economic, social, world, liberty, culture, ecological, technology and institutional themes were checked; unsupported positions remain null. Milk price-support evidence concerns his own historical measure; later dairy safety-net mechanisms need not reproduce its design. Opposition to school prayer was not extended to all religious instruction.
